description: This is a Java source file for an Android application activity 'Login' that handles user login functionality, including UI interactions, network requests for authentication, and data parsing.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: An Android activity class managing user login, including UI setup, network communication (login request), and response handling with data parsing and navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the login activity, sets the layout, and configures the login button click listener.

methods.name: checkFields
methods.description: Checks whether both email and password fields are filled.

methods.name: POST_Request
methods.description: Sends a POST request for user authentication using Volley, and defines response and error handlers.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Parses the server response JSON to verify login success, retrieves additional data, updates global variables, and navigates to MainActivity.
